description:
The `gf2-sim` Rayleigh and Rician stages compute $r = h x + n$ and discard $h$, so the downstream Gray-QAM demap stages compute LLRs under an AWGN metric. Fading-channel LLRs from the stage pipeline are therefore mismatched to the channel.

## Background

`SymbolBatch` (`crates/gf2-sim/src/batch.rs`) carries only I/Q lanes. `Rayleigh::apply` and `Rician::apply` (`crates/gf2-sim/src/channels/`) draw a per-symbol complex gain and apply it to the symbol without exposing it. `GrayQamDemapCore::demap_frame` (`crates/gf2-sim/src/stages/mod.rs`) always passes `gain_i: None`, `gain_q: None` and a single scalar `noise_var` in `DemapInput`.

The modem layer already supports coherent fading demapping: `DemapInput::gain_i` / `gain_q` accept per-symbol complex gains, and `gf2_coding::fading::QpskRicianChannelModel` uses them. The missing piece is the `gf2-sim` pipeline data model.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Fading channel stages expose the per-symbol complex gain they apply to downstream stages through the pipeline's batch type.
- [hard] REQ-02: The CPU Gray-QAM demap stages (DVB-T2 and NR) pass the per-symbol gain to `DemapInput::gain_i` / `gain_q` when present, and `None` for AWGN.
- [hard] REQ-03: For a fixed seed, demapped LLRs from a Rayleigh stage chain equal the LLRs produced by calling `FastGrayQamDemapper` directly with the same received samples and gains, bit for bit.
- [hard] REQ-04: AWGN-chain outputs and the existing byte-identity suites are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-05: The per-symbol RNG word budget and `FRAME_STRIDE` contract of the fading stages are unchanged.

## Notes

Perfect channel-state information at the receiver is the target model. Estimated-CSI receivers are a separate concern.
title: Carry channel gains from gf2-sim fading stages to the soft demapper
